summary: Both edits carry all of the intent and are the same apart from node ids. Both add new nodes whose file paths the intent never names, and both state several requirements twice, once in the modify note and again on the new nodes and edges.

findings.detail: The new node lists files "packages/app-store/_lib/crm-enums.ts" and "packages/app-store/_lib/crm-schemas.ts". The intent only says "the shared CRM enums and schemas" and gives no files or location, so these paths are invented.

The new node lists files "packages/lib/server/repository/TrackingRepository.interface.ts" and "packages/lib/server/repository/PrismaTrackingRepository.ts". The intent only says "the injected tracking repository" and names neither file nor location.

"Store the enable switch and field mappings in the HubSpot app configuration using the shared CRM enums and schemas ... WriteToObjectSettings" appears in the CRM modify note, again in the crm-shared-enums-schemas node note, and again in edge e-crm-uses-crm-enums-schemas.

"tracking repository for UTM data keyed by booking UID" appears in both the tracking-repository node note and the e-crm-reads-tracking edge note. "keep missing optional tracking ... from corrupting the ordinary meeting payload" appears in both the modify note and the edge note.
